findings.detail: The extracted holding for Arcstor Midco has blank interest_rate even though the source row carries SF index, 7.60% spread, and a 3.75% PIK rate cell.

rationale: Class 2/within-schedule localization: the bundle's holdings slice shows Arcstor Midco, LLC, Senior Secured Loans, Due 3/16/2027 with observed interest_rate blank, while the raw investment schedule row has a populated basis/spread/rate sequence: SF index, 7.60% spread, and 3.75% PIK in the rate cell. The source therefore decides the issue as an extraction gap rather than a false alarm. Schedule fair-value totals were checked only as context and tie to the filing total, so no aggregate anchor disagreement is asserted.
